sources.title: ModelFront for Tamil | ModelFront
sources.snippet: ModelFront provides AI to check and fix AI translations between hundreds of languages, including Tamil. ModelFront's private custom LLMs for quality prediction and automatic post-editing were fundamentally built to support more than 100 languages from day one.
